 svt_mipi_cphy_configuration  rand bit  force_enable_line_sampling = 0; This variable is to indicate that RX FSM should be enabled in case it was disabled by the CPHY lane module or upper layer internally. If respective C-PHY lane module only support unidirectional flow from MASTER -> SLAVE, then TX FSM is enabled and RX FSM is disabled in active unidirectional MASTER CPHY lane modules. Transmitted data is not sampled from the interface lines(A,B & C) for active unidirectional MASTER CPHY lane modules. Transmitted lane transaction is directly send to the respective analysis port/upper layer once TX FSM transmission is over. To enable these line based sampling for active unidirectional MASTER CPHY lane modules, set this variable value to one. SLAVE CPHY lane module RX FSM is enable by default irrespective the value of this variable. For bi-directional CPHY MASTER/SLAVE lane module RX FSM is by default enabled with TX FSM. This variable has no relevance in case of bi-directional CPHY lane module/SLAVE CPHY lane module. Implicitly upper layer take cares to enable the RX FSM. Default is 0.

 svt_mipi_cphy_configuration   function bit  get_prop_val ( string prop_name , ref bit [1023:0] prop_val , input int array_ix , ref svt_sequence_item_base data_obj )  This method is used by a component's command interface, to allow command code to retrieve the value of a single named property of a data class derived from this class. If the prop_name argument does not match a property of the class, or if the array_ix argument is not zero and does not point to a valid array element, this function returns '0'. Otherwise it returns '1', with the value of the prop_val argument assigned to the value of the specified property. However, If the property is a sub-object, a reference to it is assigned to the data_obj (ref) argument.

 svt_configuration  string  inst = SVT_UNSET_INST_NAME; Used to in some situations to define the Instance Name of a component prior to its construction. Mainly used in situations where the creating component is creating multiple sub-components where those sub-components do not have obvious names. E.g., an env creating multiple masters could name them master[0], master[1], etc. But the user may want to name them CPU, CTRLR, etc. Some components therefore use this to support a mechanism for overriding the default names (e.g., master[0], etc.) with more useful testbench provided names (e.g., CPU, etc.).

 svt_sequence_item_base  static int  max_array_elem_display = SVT_MAX_ARRAY_ELEM_DISPLAY_DEFAULT; Used by all svt_data derived display methods to limit the number of array entries which are displayed whenever an array data member is displayed. If the number of array elements is less than or equal to the max_array_elem_display value or max_array_elem_display is set to -1, then all array elements are displayed. If max_array_elem_display is set to 0, then only the array size will be displayed. Otherwise max_array_elem_display array elements are displayed. Since this field is not owned by an individual instance, it is not copied, compared, etc., like the other svt_data properties. Initial value set to SVT_MAX_ARRAY_ELEM_DISPLAY_DEFAULT so it can be overridden at compile time.

 svt_mipi_cphy_configuration  rand bit  ppi_eot_all_ones = 1'b1; Indicates whether first eot word will be all ones or all zeros. This configuration is applicable only to PPI_PHY_REMOTE and PPI_PHY_SERIAL mode. 0: First EOT word will be all zeros. 1: First EOT word will be all ones. Default value is 1'b1.  
 svt_mipi_cphy_configuration  rand bit  ppi_eot_app_processing = 1'b0; Indicates EOT APP processing. This configuration is applicable only to PPI_PHY_REMOTE and PPI_PHY_SERIAL mode. Set to 1'b1 if eot processing is done at the APP which means one or more EOT words are appended at the end of the data transmission. Set to 1'b0 if eot processing is done at the PHY level. Default value is 1'b0.  
 svt_mipi_cphy_configuration  rand bit  ppi_force_rx_user_mode = 1'b0; This configuration is used to override the force_rx_mode setting done by the APP layer. When set, the ppi_force_rx_user_value is used in place of force_rx_mode set by APP. In PPI_APP_LOCAL mode, when this configuration is set then ppi_force_rx_user_value is assigned to the force_rx_mode at the PPI interface else the force_rx_mode set by APP is assigned. Default value is 1'b0. NOTE: It is recommended to set the user mode at initialization or at stop state when no transaction communication is happening on the lines. 
 svt_mipi_cphy_configuration  rand bit  ppi_force_rx_user_value = 1'b0; This configuration is used to set the override value for force_rx_mode when in user override mode. When ppi_force_rx_user_mode is set, the ppi_force_rx_user_value is used in place of force_rx_mode set by APP. In PPI_APP_LOCAL mode, this value is assigned to force_rx_mode at PPI interface when ppi_force_rx_user_mode is set else the force_rx_mode set by APP is assigned. Default value is 1'b0. NOTE: It is recommended to set the user mode at initialization or at stop state when no transaction communication is happening on the lines.

Default value is 1'b0. NOTE: It is recommended to set the user mode at initialization or at stop state when no transaction communication is happening on the lines. 
 svt_mipi_cphy_configuration  rand bit  ppi_force_tx_user_value = 1'b0; This configuration is used to set the override value for force_tx_stop_mode when in user override mode.  svt_mipi_cphy_configuration  rand bit [SVT_MIPI_CPHY_PPI_RX_DATA_WIDTH_HS_VECTOR_WIDTH-1:0]  ppi_rx_data_width_hs = SVT_MIPI_CPHY_PPI_RX_WORD_VALID_HS_VECTOR_WIDTH; rx_data_width_hs to define the data width in hs mode for ppi rx signals and values are as follows: Bit[1:0] = 2'b00, not used and reserved Bit[1:0] = 2'b01, for 16-bit data width Bit[1:0] = 2'b10, for 32-bit data width Bit[1:0] = 2'b11, not used and reserved The default value of this field is same as the user define SVT_MIPI_CPHY_PPI_RX_WORD_VALID_HS_VECTOR_WIDTH which is 1 for 16 bits and 2 for 32 bits.

When ppi_turn_disable_user_mode is set, the ppi_turn_disable_user_value is used in place of turn_disable set by APP. In PPI_APP_LOCAL mode, this value is assigned to turn_disable at PPI interface when ppi_turn_disable_user_mode is set else the turn_disable set by APP is assigned. Default value is 1'b0. NOTE: It is recommended to set the user mode at initialization or at stop state when no transaction communication is happening on the lines. 
 svt_mipi_cphy_configuration  rand int unsigned  ppi_turn_request_assertion_max = SVT_MIPI_CPHY_PPI_TURN_REQUEST_ASSERTION_MAX; This variable is used to store the maximum assertion duration (in LP clk) of the TurnRequest signal at the PPI interface during BTA request when PPI_TURN_REQUEST_RANDOM mode is used. 
 svt_mipi_cphy_configuration  rand int unsigned  ppi_turn_request_assertion_min = SVT_MIPI_CPHY_PPI_TURN_REQUEST_ASSERTION_MIN; This variable is used to store the minimum assertion duration (in LP clk) of the TurnRequest signal at the PPI interface during BTA request when PPI_TURN_REQUEST_RANDOM mode is used. 
 svt_mipi_cphy_configuration  enum  ppi_turn_request_mode_enum  PPI interface signal turn_request modes.  
 svt_mipi_cphy_configuration  typedef  ppi_turn_request_mode_enum   
 svt_mipi_cphy_configuration  enum value  PPI_TURN_REQUEST_PULSE   
 svt_mipi_cphy_configuration  enum value  PPI_TURN_REQUEST_RANDOM   
 svt_mipi_cphy_configuration  rand svt_mipi_cphy_configuration :: ppi_turn_request_mode_enum  ppi_turn_request_signal_mode Indicates PPI Turn Request signal Mode during trigger transactions. There are 3 variations. PPI_TURN_REQUEST_PULSE: TurnRequest signal gets de-asserted after one (LP) clock. PPI_TURN_REQUEST_UNTIL_BTA: TurnRequest signal gets de-asserted when direction flips/timeout happens. PPI_TURN_REQUEST_RANDOM: TurnRequest signal gets de-asserted after random number of (LP) clocks. The random delay is generated between ppi_turn_request_assertion_min and ppi_turn_request_assertion_max variables and if the random delay overshoots the BTA completion (direction flip or timeout), it gets trimmed at BTA completion. Default value is PPI_TURN_REQUEST_RANDOM.  
 svt_mipi_cphy_configuration  enum value  PPI_TURN_REQUEST_UNTIL_BTA   
 svt_mipi_cphy_configuration  rand bit [SVT_MIPI_CPHY_PPI_TX_DATA_WIDTH_HS_VECTOR_WIDTH-1:0]  ppi_tx_data_width_hs = SVT_MIPI_CPHY_PPI_TX_WORD_VALID_HS_VECTOR_WIDTH; tx_data_width_hs to define the data width in hs mode for ppi tx signals and values are as follows: Bit[1:0] = 2'b00, not used and reserved Bit[1:0] = 2'b01, for 16-bit data width Bit[1:0] = 2'b10, for 32-bit data width Bit[1:0] = 2'b11, not used and reserved The default value of this field is same as the user define SVT_MIPI_CPHY_PPI_TX_WORD_VALID_HS_VECTOR_WIDTH which is 1 for 16 bits and 2 for 32 bits.

 svt_mipi_cphy_configuration  rand int unsigned  ppi_tx_lpdt_esc_assertion_min = SVT_MIPI_CPHY_PPI_TX_LPDT_ESC_ASSERTION_MIN; This variable is used to store the minimum assertion duration of the TxLpdtEsc signal at the PPI interface when PPI_TX_LPDT_ESC_RANDOM mode is used.

 svt_mipi_cphy_configuration  rand svt_mipi_cphy_configuration :: ppi_tx_lpdt_esc_mode_enum  ppi_tx_lpdt_esc_signal_mode Indicates PPI TxLpdtEsc signal Mode. There are 3 variations. PPI_TX_LPDT_ESC_PULSE: TxLpdtEsc signal gets asserted when TxRequestEsc is asserted and gets de-asserted after one clk. PPI_TX_LPDT_ESC_SAME_AS_REQ: TxLpdtEsc signal gets asserted when TxRequestEsc is asserted and gets de-asserted when TxRequestEsc gets de-asserted PPI_TX_LPDT_ESC_RANDOM: TxLpdtEsc signal gets asserted when TxRequestEsc is asserted and gets de-asserted after random number of clks between the min/max range defined by ppi_tx_lpdt_esc_assertion_min and ppi_tx_lpdt_esc_assertion_max variables. Default value is PPI_TX_LPDT_ESC_RANDOM.  
 svt_mipi_cphy_configuration  rand bit  ppi_tx_lpdt_req_to_data_delay = 1'b0; This variable is used to indicate if there needs to be a delay (of one clock) between tx_request_esc and tx_data_esc. The byte boundary delay for the first data transaction if configured would start after this delay. 0 : There is no delay. 1 : There is one clock delay The default value is 1'b0.  
 svt_mipi_cphy_configuration  rand int unsigned  ppi_tx_trigger_esc_assertion_max = SVT_MIPI_CPHY_PPI_TX_TRIGGER_ESC_ASSERTION_MAX; This variable is used to store the maximum assertion duration of the TxTriggerEsc signal at the PPI interface when PPI_TX_TRIGGER_ESC_RANDOM mode is used.

 svt_mipi_cphy_configuration  rand svt_mipi_cphy_configuration :: ppi_tx_trigger_esc_mode_enum  ppi_tx_trigger_esc_signal_mode Indicates PPI TxTriggerEsc signal Mode. There are 3 variations. PPI_TX_TRIGGER_ESC_PULSE: TxTriggerEsc signal gets asserted when TxRequestEsc is asserted and gets de-asserted after one clk. PPI_TX_TRIGGER_ESC_SAME_AS_REQ: TxTriggerEsc signal gets asserted when TxRequestEsc is asserted and gets de-asserted when TxRequestEsc gets de-asserted PPI_TX_TRIGGER_ESC_RANDOM: TxTriggerEsc signal gets asserted when TxRequestEsc is asserted and gets de-asserted after random number of clks between the min/max range defined by ppi_tx_trigger_esc_assertion_min and ppi_tx_trigger_esc_assertion_max variables. In case the random delay overshoots TxRequestEsc then TxTriggerEsc is de-asserted along with TxRequestEsc. Default value is PPI_TX_TRIGGER_ESC_RANDOM.  
 svt_mipi_cphy_configuration  rand int unsigned  ppi_tx_trigger_req_assertion_max = SVT_MIPI_CPHY_PPI_TX_TRIGGER_REQ_ASSERTION_MAX; This variable is used to store the maximum assertion duration of the TxRequestEsc signal at the PPI interface during trigger transaction when PPI_TX_TRIGGER_REQ_RANDOM mode is used. 
 svt_mipi_cphy_configuration  rand int unsigned  ppi_tx_trigger_req_assertion_min = SVT_MIPI_CPHY_PPI_TX_TRIGGER_REQ_ASSERTION_MIN; This variable is used to store the minimum assertion duration of the TxRequestEsc signal at the PPI interface during trigger transaction when PPI_TX_TRIGGER_REQ_RANDOM mode is used.

 svt_mipi_cphy_configuration  rand svt_mipi_cphy_configuration :: ppi_tx_trigger_req_mode_enum  ppi_tx_trigger_req_signal_mode Indicates PPI TxRequestEsc signal Mode during trigger transactions. There are 3 variations. PPI_TX_TRIGGER_REQ_CALC: TxRequestEsc signal gets asserted for the calculated duration of the approximate time the serial layer takes to unload the trigger transaction onto the serial line considering the dummy byte configuration. PPI_TX_TRIGGER_REQ_RANDOM: TxRequestEsc signal gets asserted for a random number of clocks generated between ppi_tx_trigger_esc_assertion_min and ppi_tx_trigger_esc_assertion_max variables. Default value is PPI_TX_TRIGGER_ESC_CALC.

PPI_TX_ULPS_EXIT_SAME_AS_REQ: TxUlpsExit signal gets asserted when APP layer requests ULPS exit to PPI layer and gets de-asserted when TxRequestEsc gets de-asserted. PPI_TX_ULPS_EXIT_RANDOM: TxUlpsExit signal gets asserted when APP layer requests ULPS exit to PPI layer and gets de-asserted after random number of clks between the min/max range defined by ppi_tx_ulps_exit_assertion_min and ppi_tx_ulps_exit_assertion_max variables. In case the random number of clocks overshoots the TxRequestEsc then TxUlpsExit gets de-asserted along with TxRequestEsc Default value is PPI_TX_ULPS_EXIT_RANDOM.  
 svt_mipi_cphy_configuration  bit [15:0]   prbs9_initial_seed = SVT_MIPI_CPHY_PRBS_INITIAL_SEED; PRBS9 generator initial 16 bit seed value. Default value is 'h0001 (SVT_MIPI_CPHY_PRBS_INITIAL_SEED). 
 svt_mipi_cphy_configuration  rand bit [2:0]   preamble_check_en = 3'b100; Three bit vector values enable/disable protocol checks for Preamble phase (Prebegin, Progseq & Preend). preamble_check_en[SVT_MIPI_CPHY_PREAMBLE_PREBEGIN_CHECK_EN_BIT] Enables/Disables Prebegin check (0=OFF, 1=ON) preamble_check_en[SVT_MIPI_CPHY_PREAMBLE_PROGSEQ_CHECK_EN_BIT] Enables/Disables Progseq check (0=OFF, 1=ON) preamble_check_en[SVT_MIPI_CPHY_PREAMBLE_PREEND_CHECK_EN_BIT] Enables/Disables Pre-end check (0=OFF, 1=ON). Default value is 3'b100 (PREEND Check is enabled).

 svt_sequence_item_base   function bit  save_child_refs ( svt_xml_writer writer , string prefix = "" )  This method can be used to write out Unique IDs for the children of this object using the XML format. The extended class must drive this process, but can use the save_ref method on the to individual children to output those children.  
 svt_sequence_item_base   function bit  save_object_begin ( svt_xml_writer writer )  This method uses the 'writer' class methods to write out the object begin data to file. This method is intoduced to resolve the Verdi call back issue where during concurrent transaction the order of the transaction has to be correct otherwise Verdi dumper APIs will have performance issue.  
 svt_sequence_item_base   function bit  save_object_data ( svt_xml_writer writer , string prefix = "" )  This method writes the object start to XML/FSDB file, This method is introduced to resolve the Verdi call back issue where during concurrent transaction the order of the transaction as to be correct otherwise Verdi dumper APIs will have performance issue.  
 svt_sequence_item_base   function bit  save_pattern_to_xml ( svt_xml_writer writer , svt_pa_object_data pa_obj_data , svt_pattern pttrn , string prefix = "" )  This method writes the property values stored in the pattern to the indicated file using the XML format.  
 svt_sequence_item_base   function bit  save_prop_vals ( string filename = "", int file = 0, string prefix = "" )  This method saves the property values to the indicated file using a basic text format. If filename specified without file then creates file handle and uses it to saves the values. If file specified without filename then uses file to save the values. If both filename and file specified than no save is attempted and the failure is indicated via the return.  
 svt_sequence_item_base   function bit  save_prop_vals_to_fsdb ( string inst_name , string parent_object_uid = "", string stream_attr_name stream_attr_name = [$], string stream_attr_val stream_attr_val = [$] )  This method writes the property values associated with this data object to an FSDB file.  
 svt_sequence_item_base   function bit  save_prop_vals_to_fsdb_internal ( string top_level_name , string object_channel , string parent_object_uid = "", string object_uid = "", string prefix = "" )  This is an internal method and should not be used by external components.  
 svt_sequence_item_base   function bit  save_prop_vals_to_xml ( svt_xml_writer writer , string object_block_desc = "", string prefix = "" )  This method writes the property values to the indicated file using the XML format. This method relies on the allocate_xml_pattern method to obtain the pattern for the property values to be saved. Therefore the preferred mechanism for altering the format is to overload the allocate_xml_pattern to define a different pattern.  
 svt_sequence_item_base   function bit  save_ref ( svt_xml_writer writer , string prefix = "" )  This method can be used to write out the Unique IDs for an object using the XML format.  
 svt_mipi_cphy_configuration   function bit  set_prop_val ( string prop_name , bit [1023:0] prop_val , int array_ix )  This method is used by a component's command interface, to allow command code to set the value of a single named property of a data class derived from this class. This method cannot be used to set the value of a sub-object, since sub-object construction is taken care of automatically by the command interface. If the prop_name argument does not match a property of the class, or it matches a sub-object of the class, or if the array_ix argument is not zero and does not point to a valid array element, this function returns '0'. Otherwise it returns '1'.

 svt_mipi_cphy_configuration  rand bit [7:0]   tgr_post_length = SVT_MIPI_CPHY_TGR_POST_LENGTH_MAX; tgr_post_length register bit mapping and default value is as follows: Bit[7:5] Reserved, will be set to 0. Bit[4:0] This field is used to set the number of symbols to be transmitted after sending programmable sequence. The number of transmitted symbol is {(tgr_post_length[4:0] + 1) * 7}. The default value of this field is 31 (0x1F).  
 svt_mipi_cphy_configuration  rand bit [7:0]   tgr_preamble_length = SVT_MIPI_CPHY_TGR_PREBEGIN_LENGTH_MAX; tgr_preamble_length register bit mapping and default value is as follows: Bit[7] This field is used to enable transmission of programmable sequence if set to 1. The default value of this field is 0. Bit[6] Reserved, will be set to 0. Bit[5:0] This field is used to set the number of symbols to be transmitted before sending programmable sequence. The number of transmitted symbol is {(tgr_preamble_length[5:0] + 1) * 7}. The default value of this field is 63 (0x3F).  
 svt_mipi_cphy_configuration  rand bit [7:0]   tgr_preamble_prog_sequence_0_1 = { 2'd0 , 3'd3 , 3'd3 }; tgr_preamble_prog_sequence_0_1 register bit mapping and default value is as follows: Bit[7:6] Reserved, will be set to 0. Bit[5:3] This field is used to set symbol1 sequence pattern to be transmitted while sending programmable sequence. Bit[2:0] This field is used to set symbol0 sequence pattern to be transmitted while sending programmable sequence. Valid range for Bit[5:3] and Bit[2:0] is 0 to 4, with 3 being the default value.  
 svt_mipi_cphy_configuration  rand bit [7:0]   tgr_preamble_prog_sequence_10_11 = { 2'd0 , 3'd3 , 3'd3 }; tgr_preamble_prog_sequence_10_11 register bit mapping and default value is as follows: Bit[7:6] Reserved, will be set to 0. Bit[5:3] This field is used to set symbol11 sequence pattern to be transmitted while sending programmable sequence. Bit[2:0] This field is used to set symbol10 sequence pattern to be transmitted while sending programmable sequence. Valid range for Bit[5:3] and Bit[2:0] is 0 to 4, with 3 being the default value.  
 svt_mipi_cphy_configuration  rand bit [7:0]   tgr_preamble_prog_sequence_12_13 = { 2'd0 , 3'd3 , 3'd3 }; tgr_preamble_prog_sequence_12_13 register bit mapping and default value is as follows: Bit[7:6] Reserved, will be set to 0. Bit[5:3] This field is used to set symbol13 sequence pattern to be transmitted while sending programmable sequence. Bit[2:0] This field is used to set symbol12 sequence pattern to be transmitted while sending programmable sequence. Valid range for Bit[5:3] and Bit[2:0] is 0 to 4, with 3 being the default value.  
 svt_mipi_cphy_configuration  rand bit [7:0]   tgr_preamble_prog_sequence_2_3 = { 2'd0 , 3'd3 , 3'd3 }; tgr_preamble_prog_sequence_2_3 register bit mapping and default value is as follows: Bit[7:6] Reserved, will be set to 0. Bit[5:3] This field is used to set symbol3 sequence pattern to be transmitted while sending programmable sequence. Bit[2:0] This field is used to set symbol2 sequence pattern to be transmitted while sending programmable sequence. Valid range for Bit[5:3] and Bit[2:0] is 0 to 4, with 3 being the default value.  
 svt_mipi_cphy_configuration  rand bit [7:0]   tgr_preamble_prog_sequence_4_5 = { 2'd0 , 3'd3 , 3'd3 }; tgr_preamble_prog_sequence_4_5 register bit mapping and default value is as follows: Bit[7:6] Reserved, will be set to 0. Bit[5:3] This field is used to set symbol5 sequence pattern to be transmitted while sending programmable sequence. Bit[2:0] This field is used to set symbol4 sequence pattern to be transmitted while sending programmable sequence. Valid range for Bit[5:3] and Bit[2:0] is 0 to 4, with 3 being the default value.  
 svt_mipi_cphy_configuration  rand bit [7:0]   tgr_preamble_prog_sequence_6_7 = { 2'd0 , 3'd3 , 3'd3 }; tgr_preamble_prog_sequence_6_7 register bit mapping and default value is as follows: Bit[7:6] Reserved, will be set to 0.  svt_mipi_cphy_configuration  real  tx_t_3_alp_pause_stop = SVT_MIPI_CPHY_TX_T_3_ALP_PAUSE_STOP; T3-ALP-PAUSE Tx STOP State Time that transmitter asserts the ALP-Pause Stop state. Default value : 90 (ns)  
 svt_mipi_cphy_configuration  real  tx_t_3_alp_pause_ulps = SVT_MIPI_CPHY_TX_T_3_ALP_PAUSE_ULPS; T3-ALP-PAUSE Tx ULPS State Time that transmitter asserts the ALP-Pause ULPS state. Default value : 0.5 (ms)

 svt_mipi_cphy_configuration  real  tx_t_3_alp_pause_wake_ulps = SVT_MIPI_CPHY_TX_T_3_ALP_PAUSE_WAKE_ULPS; T3-ALP-PAUSE-WAKE Tx ULPS State Time that the Transmitter asserts the ALP-Pause Wake pulse from the ALP-Pause ULPS state. Default value : 1 (ms)  
 svt_mipi_cphy_configuration  rand bit  t_3_prepare_check_en = 1'b1; This variable is used to enable or disable t3-Prepare duration check 0 : Disabled 1 : Enabled Default is 1 (Enabled)  
 svt_mipi_cphy_configuration  rand int unsigned  trigger_dummy_bytes_max = 0; This variable is used to define the maximum range of trigger dummy bytes. Trigger_dummy_bytes_max value should be zero when dummy bytes transmission not required after trigger commands. Trigger_dummy_bytes_max value should be non-zero and greater or equal to trigger_dummy_bytes_min, only in cases when dummy bytes transmission is required. Model will randomly generate number of trigger dummy bytes value between trigger_dummy_bytes_min & trigger_dummy_bytes_max. Generated value will indicate the number of trigger dummy bytes need to be transmitted. Default is 0.  
 svt_mipi_cphy_configuration  rand int unsigned  trigger_dummy_bytes_min = SVT_MIPI_CPHY_TRIGGER_DUMMY_BYTES_MIN; This variable is used to define the minimum range of trigger dummy bytes. Trigger_dummy_bytes_min value should be zero when dummy bytes transmission not required after trigger commands. Trigger_dummy_bytes_min value should be non-zero and smaller or equal to trigger_dummy_bytes_max, only in cases when dummy bytes transmission is required. Model will randomly generate number of trigger dummy bytes value between trigger_dummy_bytes_min & trigger_dummy_bytes_max. Generated value will indicate the number of trigger dummy bytes need to be transmitted. Default is SVT_MIPI_CPHY_TRIGGER_DUMMY_BYTES_MIN (0)  
 svt_mipi_cphy_configuration  rand bit [1:0]   trigger_dummy_bytes_value = 2; This variable is used to indicate dummy bytes value. 0 : All zero value will be considered for dummy bytes. 1 : All one value will be considered for dummy bytes. 2 : Random value will be considered for dummy bytes. 3 : Reserved(Not allowed). Default is 2 (Random value)
